summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Dominica documents: ten budget addresses (FY2015/16-FY2026/27), six IMF Article IV reports (2016-2024), two CBI Unit brochures (2024), a CRS Insight and Regulation (EU) 2025/2441. Adds every printed year and column of CBI revenue and balances excluding CBI from the IMF fiscal and BOP tables (statuses kept by column: outturn, preliminary/estimate, projection), CBI bank accounts and spending by project from the 2016/17 budget address, CBI budget financing for FY2016/17 (image table, OCR), CBI-funded projects (hotel rooms, housing units, airport cost, health centres, school), programme fees and terms, and VRF/DRF figures. Seven new indicators are proposed.

Room counts and the two projects approved in principle are recorded (new indicator cbi_project_hotel_rooms proposed); the 90-room Soufriere hotel is only "being reviewed" (not approved) and the Cabrits Hotel Resort and Spa (68 rooms) is funded by Morocco and the Government, so neither is recorded.

Budget address for FY2016/17 (50 pages): economy, FY2015/16 fiscal outturn, debt, post-Tropical Storm Erika recovery, 2016/17 estimates, PSIP by ministry, sector measures, social measures.
